message: I always keep a little flashlight and some extra batteries handy, and it's saved my sanity on more than one occasion during a blackout! It's amazing how a small win like that can make a big difference when the lights go out. If you’re curious about more tips on preparing for those unexpected power outages, check out this great resource from the Red Cross. What’s your go-to trick for staying cozy when the power's out? 💡
